errors.text_span: wobei der Wert bei 0 beginnt und bei 81,0 maximal erreicht wird
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the maximum value of the vertical axis is 81.0. The axis actually extends to 90, while 81.0 is the maximum data point shown on a bar.

errors.text_span: Die Werte auf der vertikalen Achse sind in 10er-Schritten aufgereiht, wobei die Ticks die Werte 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80 und 90 markieren.
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the vertical axis are 0, 30, 60, and 90, meaning the interval is 30, not 10.
The chart shows one bar for each year from 2000 to 2024, which is a total of 25 bars, not 68.

errors.text_span: die fast alle in einer ähnlichen Höhe angeordnet sind und eine weitgehend konstante Höhe zwischen 58,7 und 68,1 aufweisen
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization as it downplays the significant variation in the data, particularly the peak at 81.0, which is well outside the stated range.

errors.text_span: wobei der höchste Balken einen Wert von 81,0 im Jahr 2018 aufweist
errors.evidence: The highest bar, with a value of 81.0, corresponds to the year 2010, not 2018.

errors.text_span: und der niedrigste Balken einen Wert von 62,9 für das Jahr 2020 aufweist
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in multiple ways. The lowest value shown is 58.7 for the year 2018. The value 62.9 corresponds to the year 2022, and the value for 2020 is 68.1.
The description fails to mention a key visual feature: the last two bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are a lighter shade of blue, suggesting they may represent projected or estimated data.
The description does not mention the presence of a horizontal black reference line drawn across the chart at approximately the 60 mark on the y-axis.
